name: Bajaj Auto Ltd
about: Bajaj Auto, the flagship company of Bajaj Group, is a two-wheeler and three-wheeler manufacturing company that exports to 79 countries across several countries in Latin America, Southeast Asia, and many more. Its headquarter is in Pune, India. The company has acquired 76% of the KTM Brand which manufactures sports and super sports two-wheelers, which was 14% in 2007 when the company first acquired KTM. [1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] Bajaj Auto develops, manufactures, and sells 2-wheelers, 3-wheelers, quadricycles, and parts and accessories. Automotive accounted for 97% of standalone revenue and its segments are Automotive, Financing, and Investments. The company's wholesale customers are mainly dealers and distributors, with 2,598 of them accounting for 99% of FY26 sales. Bajaj Auto Credit supports retail sales through captive financing.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 29.2%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 48.2%
Promoter holding has increased by 0.94% over last quarter.
